summary: Letter urges the FCC to preserve the E‑Rate program and oppose any proposal to reduce, limit, or sunset it.

claims.argument: Opposing any sunset or reduction of E‑Rate funding is essential to maintain equitable broadband access for all students.
claims.evidence_quote: iting to urge the Federal Communications Commission to preserve and protect the E-Rate program and to oppose any proposal that would reduce, limit, or sunset this vital source of support for schools
